b2-argentinasociedad-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Views of Peronism
b2-argentinasociedad-01.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are watching a documentary about Peronism, and he asks what you learned about Perón's government.
b2-argentinasociedad-01.prompt: Tell Carlos what supporters liked and what critics said, joined by a contrast connector.
cues: Say that the government extended rights
Add what critics said, with a contrast connector
b2-argentinasociedad-01.target: Se ampliaron los derechos laborales; no obstante, los críticos decían que el gobierno limitaba la prensa.
b2-argentinasociedad-01.english: Labour rights were extended; nevertheless, the critics said the government limited the press.
b2-argentinasociedad-01.canDo: I can set two views of Peronism side by side with *sin embargo* and *no obstante*.

b2-argentinasociedad-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The CONADEP
b2-argentinasociedad-02.scenario: You are Carlos. You have read an article about the last dictatorship, and Meg asks what the CONADEP was.
b2-argentinasociedad-02.prompt: Tell Meg who created the CONADEP and when, using a passive.
b2-argentinasociedad-02.target: La CONADEP fue creada por el presidente Alfonsín en 1983.
b2-argentinasociedad-02.english: The CONADEP was created by President Alfonsín in 1983.
b2-argentinasociedad-02.canDo: I can say what was done to people and institutions under the dictatorship with *ser* + participle.

b2-argentinasociedad-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Search of the Abuelas
b2-argentinasociedad-03.scenario: You are Meg. You are reading about the Abuelas de Plaza de Mayo for a class, and Carlos asks what they do.
b2-argentinasociedad-03.prompt: Tell Carlos whom the Abuelas are looking for.
cues: Say that they look for grandchildren
Say that those people may not know their origin
b2-argentinasociedad-03.target: Las Abuelas buscan a nietos que no conozcan su verdadero origen.
b2-argentinasociedad-03.english: The Abuelas look for grandchildren who may not know their true origin.
b2-argentinasociedad-03.canDo: I can describe the people the Abuelas de Plaza de Mayo are looking for with a relative clause and the subjunctive.

b2-argentinasociedad-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Maradona
b2-argentinasociedad-04.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are watching a documentary about the 1986 World Cup, and she asks why Maradona is so famous.
b2-argentinasociedad-04.prompt: Tell Meg about Maradona, with a superlative.
cues: Say that he is one of the most famous players
Say in which World Cup Argentina won with him
b2-argentinasociedad-04.target: Maradona es uno de los jugadores más famosos de la historia, y en 1986 ganó el Mundial con Argentina.
b2-argentinasociedad-04.english: Maradona is one of the most famous players in history, and in 1986 he won the World Cup with Argentina.
b2-argentinasociedad-04.canDo: I can rank moments and people of Argentine football with *uno de los más…*.

b2-argentinasociedad-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Corralito
b2-argentinasociedad-05.scenario: You are Meg. You are giving a short talk about the crisis of 2001, and Carlos asks why people were angry.
b2-argentinasociedad-05.prompt: Tell Carlos why people could not use their money, with a cause connector.
cues: Say that there was a limit on withdrawals
Say what people could not do with their savings
b2-argentinasociedad-05.target: Debido al corralito, mucha gente no podía sacar sus ahorros del banco.
b2-argentinasociedad-05.english: Because of the corralito, many people could not take their savings out of the bank.
b2-argentinasociedad-05.canDo: I can give the causes of the 2001 crisis with *debido a* and *a raíz de*.

b2-argentinasociedad-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Argentina in Brief
b2-argentinasociedad-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. You are preparing a short talk about modern Argentina, and Meg asks you to try the first lines.
b2-argentinasociedad-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg one fact about Peronism, using a contrast connector.
cues: Add that it stayed alive, with a contrast connector
b2-argentinasociedad-consolidation.target: Tras el golpe de 1955, el peronismo fue prohibido; sin embargo, siguió vivo entre los obreros.
b2-argentinasociedad-consolidation.english: After the 1955 coup Peronism was banned; however, it stayed alive among workers.
b2-argentinasociedad-consolidation.canDo: I can set two views of Peronism side by side with *sin embargo* and *no obstante*.
